title: Leadership
meta_description: Meet the leadership of Achala IT Solutions: CEO Rajesh Raju and COO Jyotish Vegesna, with the vice presidents who run engineering, quality, HR, product and the SAP practice.

blocks.x: The leadership of Achala IT Solutions Private Limited, founded in 2009 by engineers and consultants who still run delivery today.

Achala IT Solutions's leadership structure mirrors its delivery model, each executive owns a domain portfolio and the outcomes it commits to. Roles and focus areas below; names and bios are maintained by the communications team.

blocks.caption: Management team
rows: 25+ years in technology and consulting. Founder of Achala IT Solutions in 2009. B.E. Mechanical Engineering, IIT Madras; MBA, University of Chicago Booth. Management consulting experience with Fortune 500 clients across product marketing, innovation, M&A and BPO.

13+ years across technology, consulting, product development and operations in automotive, fintech and healthcare. B.Tech Information Technology, SRKR Engineering College. Also COO of Achala Health and Achala Sulzer Ltd.
Leads the engineering organization and delivery pods across all practices.
Quality engineering, test automation and delivery assurance.
Enterprise core systems and the SAP practice.

blocks.x: Three boards govern delivery: the AI Governance Board (model risk, EU AI Act conformity), the Security Board (zero-trust estate, DORA posture) and the Delivery Quality Board (SLOs, evidence, value audits). Minutes and decisions are auditable artifacts, not memories.

Executives carry a client portfolio, not just a function: the practice lead who scopes your program escalates to the domain-owning executive within one level, and the annual value audit for every outcome-linked engagement is reviewed by the CFO's office against the original baseline pack.
